investment_options.title: Index Funds
investment_options.tagline: The market's average — which is actually extraordinary.
investment_options.logic: Invests in the top 50 companies of the country. If the country grows, you grow.
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Passively managed — automatically mirrors the Nifty 50 or Nifty 500 index
No fund manager dependency — removes human bias and reduces cost significantly
Ultra-low expense ratio (0.05%–0.2%), letting more of your money compound
Historically outperforms 80–90% of actively managed funds over 10+ years
Instant diversification — you own shares in 50–500 top companies at once
Beginner-friendly — simple structure, easy to invest via monthly SIP
High liquidity — funds can be redeemed within 1–3 business days
Rides India's long-term economic growth — as the country expands, you expand
Resilient to crashes — has recovered fully after every major market downturn
Best strategy: start a SIP and leave it untouched for 10+ years

investment_options.title: Flexi Cap Funds
investment_options.tagline: Freedom to invest across all market caps.
investment_options.logic: Fund manager freely allocates between large, mid & small caps based on market conditions — best of all worlds.
investment_options.what_it_invests_in: Mix of large-cap, mid-cap, and small-cap companies
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Fund manager has complete flexibility to allocate between large, mid, and small-cap stocks
Adapts to market conditions — shifts to safety when markets are expensive, hunts growth when cheap
Best of both worlds — stability of large-caps with growth potential of smaller companies
Actively managed — skilled fund manager makes tactical decisions based on fundamentals
Moderate-to-high volatility — requires 5+ year horizon but rewards patient investors
Typically lower expense ratio than pure mid/small-cap funds (0.5%–0.8%)
Great for investors wanting growth but unwilling to take pure small-cap risk
Tax-efficient — can realize capital gains by trimming winners periodically
Diverse portfolio across sectors and market caps reduces concentration risk
Historically delivered 14–16% annual returns over full market cycles

investment_options.title: Debt Funds
investment_options.tagline: Sleep well at night. Your money is safe.
investment_options.logic: Lends your money to the government and corporations. Gets steady interest in return.
investment_options.what_it_invests_in: Government bonds, corporate loans, short-term securities
investment_options.tax_note: Taxed as per your income slab (no special rate). Best for short-term parking.
features: Lends your money to the government and top-rated corporations for fixed interest
Returns are predictable and consistent — no overnight surprise swings
Bank FDs currently offer 6.5–7.25% for 1–3 year tenures; debt funds compete well
Debt mutual funds provide better post-tax efficiency for investors in high tax brackets
Liquid funds can be redeemed within 1 business day — faster than most FDs
Perfect place to park your emergency fund instead of a regular savings account
Bond prices rise when RBI cuts interest rates — potential capital gain bonus
Near-zero default risk when investing in government securities or AAA-rated bonds
Taxed as per income slab, works best for those in the 10%–20% tax bracket
Ideal portfolio anchor — balance the volatility of equity with this stable layer

investment_options.title: T-Bills
investment_options.tagline: Risk-free returns backed by the government.
investment_options.logic: Short-term government securities. You lend to the Indian government for 91, 182, or 364 days.
investment_options.what_it_invests_in: Direct government short-term debt (91, 182, 364 day bills)
investment_options.tax_note: Interest taxed at slab rates. Completely government-backed — zero credit risk.
features: Direct borrowing by the Government of India — zero default risk, backed by sovereign guarantee
Auctions held weekly on Mondays — transparent pricing and market liquidity
Three tenures available: 91 days, 182 days, and 364 days
Currently yielding 6–6.5% depending on tenure — competitive with bank FDs
Minimum investment just ₹25,000; multiples of ₹25,000 after that
Highly liquid — can be sold anytime on the RBI Retail Direct platform or secondary market
Taxed as per your income slab; no separate long-term capital gains rate
Perfect for parking emergency funds or surplus cash short-term
Interest accrued daily — calculated accurately down to the rupee
Best suited for risk-averse investors prioritizing complete safety over returns

investment_options.title: Small Cap MF
investment_options.tagline: High risk, high reward — for the bold.
investment_options.logic: Bets on emerging high-growth companies before they become giants.
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Invests in companies ranked below the top 250 by market capitalisation
Massive growth potential — many of today's large-caps started as small-caps
High volatility — can fall 50%+ in downturns, demands a 10-year horizon minimum
Expert fund manager crucial — active stock selection drives outperformance here
Portfolio spread across 50–80 companies reduces single-stock blow-up risk
SIP strategy is especially powerful — cost-averaging smooths extreme price swings
Can experience liquidity stress during market crashes — expect exit loads
Top funds have delivered 18–22% CAGR historically over a full market cycle
Not suitable for money you may need within the next 5–7 years
Ideal for investors in their 20s or 30s with high risk appetite and long runway

investment_options.title: Mid Cap Funds
investment_options.tagline: Sweet spot between growth and stability.
investment_options.logic: Companies growing faster than large-caps but more stable than small-caps — the sweet spot.
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Companies in the 101–250 market cap range — perfect growth without extreme risk
Better fundamentals than small-caps but more upside than large-caps
Moderate volatility — can swing 30–40% in bear markets but recovers strongly
Lower competition from large institutions — more discovery opportunities for fund managers
Require 7+ year horizon to ride out cyclical downturns comfortably
Good for investors wanting equity upside but unwilling to tolerate small-cap swings
Dividend yields often higher than large-caps as companies mature
Historically delivered 15–17% CAGR over full market cycles
Portfolio spread across 60–100 companies in diverse sectors
Works best as a core growth holding in a diversified portfolio

investment_options.title: Large Cap MF
investment_options.tagline: Steady, proven growth from India's giants.
investment_options.logic: Boring but powerful. Invests in the top 100 companies. They grow, the nation grows.
investment_options.what_it_invests_in: Top 100 companies (large-cap stocks like TCS, Infosys, HDFC)
investment_options.tax_note: Gains held >1 year: 10% LTCG. Gains <1 year: 15% STCG.
features: Invests in the top 100 Indian companies by market capitalisation
These businesses are mature, profitable, and essential to India's economy
Dividends provide steady passive income on top of capital appreciation
Lower volatility than mid or small-caps — typically swings 15–25% in bear markets
Less prone to business failure — large-cap companies rarely go bankrupt
Suitable for conservative investors wanting equity returns with lower risk
Expense ratios are ultra-low (0.3–0.5%) due to passive tracking in some funds
Historically delivered 12–14% annual returns over 10+ year horizons
Beginner-friendly entry point into equity investing
Works excellently as the core holding in any balanced portfolio

investment_options.title: Gov Bonds
investment_options.tagline: Sleep peacefully. Backed by the government.
investment_options.logic: Long-term government securities. Lend to India for 5–40 years, get guaranteed interest.
investment_options.what_it_invests_in: Government securities (SDL, GOI Bonds) with fixed coupon rates
investment_options.tax_note: Interest taxed at slab rates. Interest-on-interest compounds for long durations.
features: Issued by the Government of India — zero credit risk, backed by sovereign guarantee
Available in tenures: 5, 6, 7, 10, 14, 20, 30, 40 years
Interest rates currently range 6.5–7.5% depending on tenure
Coupon paid semi-annually directly to your bank account
Highly liquid — can be sold anytime on the secondary market via stock exchange
Price fluctuates with interest rates — opportunity for capital gains if rates fall
Ideal for long-term investors like pensioners and retirees building stable corpus
Tax-efficient for those in lower tax brackets (20%–30%)
Can be held in Demat account through RBI Retail Direct or bank/broker
Best portfolio diversifier — returns often rise when stock markets fall sharply
